examples.ar: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ.
examples.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.

examples.ar: الخَيْرُ مَوْجُودٌ فِي أُمَّتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
examples.en: Goodness is present in my nation until the Day of Resurrection.
And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

examples.ar: فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ.
examples.en: So fear them not, but fear Me, if you should be believers.

examples.ar: خِدْمَةُ النَّاسِ صِيغَةٌ رَاقِيَةٌ مِنَ التَّضَامُنِ.
examples.en: Serving people is a refined formula of solidarity.

examples.ar: يُوَسِّعُ القَارِئُ خَيَالَهُ عَبْرَ كُتُبِ الخَيَالِ العِلْمِيِّ.
examples.en: The reader expands their imagination through science fiction books.

examples.ar: خُطْوَةٌ تِلْوَ الأُخْرَى، تَقَدَّمْنَا نَحْوَ الهَدَفِ.
examples.en: Step by step, we advanced toward the goal.
That, then, would be a losing return.
